web_search.description: Searches the web for public information: the founder's company at the start, and a valid general question of the founder that the FAQ does not answer, for example about a market. One search per question. It returns the results and says what to reply.

fields.query: A short search query that never contains confidential details from the conversation. Example: "Nordlicht Robotics Startup".

submit_initial.description: Writes everything down when the voice agent asks for it after the questions. It takes no input: the backend writes the founder's answers from the conversation itself, has them checked and tells the voice agent what comes next.

submit_follow_up.description: Writes the follow-up round down when the voice agent asks for it. It takes no input: the backend writes the founder's answers from the conversation itself and tells the voice agent what comes next.
